metadata.name: Open Unnerf Pack 2
metadata.description:
Open Unnerf Pack 2 is a maintained fork for The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ v1.9.7.17. Its ten adjustments are Maw of the Void, Orbitals, Stomp Immunity, Humbling Bundle, Dark Bum, The Relic, Hard-mode blue and purple fires, Magic Mushroom pools, Void choice absorption, and Sack Head. Optional Mod Config Menu Pure (F10) provides per-feature settings that apply to new runs; Continue retains the current run's choices.
Report bugs or suggest adjustments: https://github.com/Tyniann/Isaac-Repentence-Open-Unnerf-Pack/issues
Original Open Unnerf Pack by KeinNiemand; maintained fork by Tyniann. Original project: https://github.com/KeinNiemand/Isaac-Repentence-Open-Unnerf-Pack
